tours.name: Required Fields on a New Employee

name_i18n.en_US: Required Fields on a New Employee

tours.description: Learn what happens when you save a new employee without the required fields, and how to read Odoo's message.

description_i18n.en_US: Learn what happens when you save a new employee without the required fields, and how to read Odoo's message.

steps.title: Open Employees
steps.description: Employees are created in the Employees app.

description_i18n.en_US: Employees are created in the Employees app.

steps.title: New
steps.content: Click New to start an employee.

content_i18n.en_US: Click New to start an employee.

steps.description: The form opens empty. Leave the required fields empty on purpose to see how Odoo protects the data.

description_i18n.en_US: The form opens empty. Leave the required fields empty on purpose to see how Odoo protects the data.

steps.title: Save
steps.content: Click the save icon without filling anything in.

content_i18n.en_US: Click the save icon without filling anything in.

steps.description: Odoo checks the required fields when you save. A record with a required field left empty can never be stored.

description_i18n.en_US: Odoo checks the required fields when you save. A record with a required field left empty can never be stored.

steps.title: Read the message
steps.content: Read the red message. Click it to continue.

content_i18n.en_US: Read the red message. Click it to continue.

steps.description: The message lists the fields that are missing, such as the employee name. The same rule applies everywhere in Odoo: a field marked as required must be filled in before saving.

description_i18n.en_US: The message lists the fields that are missing, such as the employee name. The same rule applies everywhere in Odoo: a field marked as required must be filled in before saving.

steps.title: Discard
steps.content: Click the discard icon to leave without saving.

content_i18n.en_US: Click the discard icon to leave without saving.

steps.description: Nothing was stored. The red outline on the field shows what is missing. Fill it in and save again to create a real employee.

description_i18n.en_US: Nothing was stored. The red outline on the field shows what is missing. Fill it in and save again to create a real employee.
